newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF Nomura hearing set for 0030 GMT Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF Nomura hearing set for 0030 GMT Thursday.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said Nomura Securities Co Ltd president Junichi Ujiie will attend a hearing at the ministry on Thursday morning to air the brokerage's views on its allegedly illegal stock transactions with a corporate racketeer.

The hearing will start at 9.30 a.m. (0030 GMT) and will be open to the media. How long the hearing lasts will depend on how Ujiie responds to questions the ministry puts to him, a ministry official said.

At the hearing, the ministry will seek confirmation of allegations against Nomura in a report it received last week from Japan's securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC).
The SESC recommended that the finance minister impose penalties against Nomura, Japan's largest brokerage, for its involvement in a payoff scandal.
The SESC said Nomura compensated a client for stock trading losses through illicit deals, in violation of the Securities and Exchange Law.
Financial industry sources said penalties against Nomura may be announced within a few days after Thursday's hearing.
